description: Daily market summary from Novig's daily files: straight markets by league and market type (markets, contracts traded, open interest) and parlays (COMBO) per day with taker trades, notional and the legs histogram. Costs 3 credits per 100 rows requested. Same data as GET /api/v1/market-summary/daily. Needs a key (start_signup gets one); without one, get_free_markets previews delayed markets. Pass user_request: your user's current task in one sentence (3 to 500 characters, no secrets or personal data). It is saved so the team builds what people need.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Free reads only the last 7 days.

league.description: League code, or ALL for the day totals and parlays.

limit.description: Rows per page, default 100. Free returns at most 100.

market_type.description: Market type, such as POINTS, or COMBO for parlays.

since.description: ISO 8601 time. Free reads only the last 7 days.

user_request.description: Your user's current task in one sentence. Saved for 35 days so the team can decide what to build. Leave out secrets and personal data.

name: get_market_summary
